title: Deployment Checklist
summary: A release-day runbook for promoting a layered Fabric platform from DEV to TST to PRD: order of operations, per-layer checklists, verified tips, gates and a troubleshooting table.

pages.title: Overview
pages.description: What the runbook covers, the order of operations for all seven layers, ground rules and prerequisites.

pages.title: Layer checklists
pages.description: Deploy, configure, hydrate and verify checklists for Bronze, Silver, Gold, warehouse, semantic model, consumption lakehouse and delivery.

pages.title: Tips and watch-outs
pages.description: Five practices that prevent most deployment failures, each with the mechanism behind it, plus further watch-outs.

pages.title: Pre-flight and verification
pages.description: Checks before, during and after a deployment, the three gates between layers, per-item verification and the evidence to keep.

pages.title: Troubleshooting
pages.description: Symptom, likely cause and fix tables for blocked, duplicated, wrong-source and empty-data problems, with a triage path.
